symptom: describe -> exec of TestApp WorkflowCommons.Snip_WorkflowUserTaskView_Details: mx check CE1613 'The selected attribute System.User.FullName no longer exists.' at Text 'text11' and 'text16'
cause: Studio Pro stores an association step whose DestinationEntity is a specialization of the association's end (System.WorkflowUserTaskOutcome_User -> Administration.Account, attribute Administration.Account.FullName). The describe readers (associationTemplateParamPath, columnAttributeFromRef) printed only the associations, and resolveAssociationPathFrom had no spelling for a cast, so the step landed on System.User
insight: A step's DestinationEntity is a cast exactly when it is neither end of its association; that test needs no direction, and describe answers it with the builder's own associationEndpoints through a bare pageBuilder, so the two halves cannot disagree about an association. Spell the cast Assoc/Module.Entity/Attr (Mendix's expression form). Before shipping a describe change, diff old vs new describe over every page and snippet of the corpora (TestApp, PedApp) and round-trip every changed document through mx check: here that turned up DataGrid2 columns printing the cast too (they came back Unchanged), and one snippet still failing because System.WorkflowSubProcess is missing from modelsdk/meta/system_module.go, which was broken before as well (CE0402 old, CE0117 now).
